additional_candidates.reason: No additional official candidate inspected from public documentation simultaneously improved on CALVIN's 7D/two-view compatibility and RoboCasa365's full-instruction/per-frame semantics while meeting continuous offline 4+ stage manipulation and reproducible rollout requirements. Adding a weaker candidate would not change the top-three decision.

decision_rule.rationale: RoboCasa365 fails the three-task arm-only verification gate at audit time; CALVIN passes the continuous five-stage and exact MaIL action/camera compatibility gates; FurnitureBench remains fallback only.
decision_rule.next_gate: human benchmark approval before any dataset download or LIBERO deletion
